scope.description: What was scored: screen/board name(s) + ids, and the export the scores cite.

styleProfile.description: The committed profile from shared/design-quality.md §1, e.g. 'Modern SaaS'.

skeleton.description: The named shell + content pattern from shared/design-quality.md §5, e.g. 'Sidebar shell / Dashboard'.

evidence.description: What in the export/shape tree justifies the score. A score without visible evidence is invalid.

fix.description: Required when score < 3: the concrete revision that would raise it.

axes.description: Exactly one entry per axis, scored against the export image per shared/design-quality.md §8.

belowThreshold.description: Count of axes with score < 3 — the field brief-to-screen's branch condition reads.

id.description: Stable within the run, e.g. dq-color-01. Reused across iterations when the same issue recurs, so reports diff cleanly.

tell.description: When the issue matches a named tell from shared/design-quality.md §7, its name — reported verbatim.

measured.description: The measured value when numeric, e.g. 'accent share ~22%' or 'body measure 118ch'.

fix.description: Concrete proposed fix, naming the token/pattern to move to when applicable.

safeSet.description: true only if the fix is in the auto-apply safe set (policies/modes.json). Aesthetic fixes almost never are.

revisionPasses.description: Self-revision passes already spent (max 2 per shared/design-quality.md §8).

truncation.description: Non-empty when scope was capped/sampled — no silent truncation (AGENTS.md §12).
